scope: Integrated INK4 UI, remote app boot-mode history, StopWatch official alternate firmware metadata, DinMeter, Dial v1.1 and S31 bring-up through USB stage

checks.command: cargo +stable clippy --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p esp32sim-wasm --features jit-tests -- -D warnings
ESP32SIM_ROM_DIR=roms node tools/wasm-test.mjs hello c3-hello c6-hello p4-hello c6-energy-scan c6-contiki c6-contiki-net c6-rpl-net panel tdisplay-prices demo-stopwatch

limits: S31 is still an isolated bring-up crate, not an executable INK4 Plus board.
Existing board availability means partial support, not every official firmware or peripheral is functional.
Application-direct mode/history checks do not certify successful application initialization.
No physical hardware flashing or new combined performance claim.
privacy: Only commands, public source commit, aggregate checks and artifact hash retained; raw machine/session logs omitted.
